timing_estimate.note: ScreenSpot screenshots are larger on the CPU image path; refine after the first 25 rows of the first run. Request a lease window based on measured throughput and stop after the current run if the lease deadline is reached.

execution_notes.wrapper: each run uses cmd.exe wrapper capturing the real exit code; nvidia-smi before/after into eval_*_gpu.log; stdout/stderr logs
execution_notes.resume: same run_id plus --resume only for an interrupted run
execution_notes.abort: >7500 MiB, competing GPU job, assert/OOM, non-finite loss: stop and report

deliverables.per_run: summary JSON + details JSONL + validation JSON for four runs
deliverables.failure_ledger: handoff/TRAINING-FAILURE-LEDGER.md if any run fails or is partial
